# $ongChainn

> Free music streaming where artists keep everything and fans can own the songs they love. Built for independent artists worldwide; the first roster is Zambian.

$ongChainn (also written SONGCHAINN) is a music app at https://www.songchainn.xyz. Every song streams free. Artists release directly to fans and keep everything. Fans who want more than a stream can own a copy of a record, walk into an artist's world, book time with the artist, or back a side in a live music battle. No wallet is needed to listen or to release.

## For listeners
- Stream every record free, offline too: https://www.songchainn.xyz/discover
- Own a copy of a song you love and be counted as someone who backed the artist: https://www.songchainn.xyz/marketplace
- Enter an artist's world (streets, rooms, gallery, stage, parlour, VR): https://www.songchainn.xyz/worlds
- Listen live with everyone in the Room: https://www.songchainn.xyz/room
- Live battles with a voting crowd, WaveWarz Africa: https://www.songchainn.xyz/wavewarz-africa
- Join free: https://www.songchainn.xyz/?auth=signup

## For artists
- Release here first, then everywhere. Free, no distributor fee, no middleman: https://www.songchainn.xyz/studio
- Get paid directly to your own wallet when a fan buys a copy of your record: https://www.songchainn.xyz/keys
- Build your own world, not a page: https://www.songchainn.xyz/world-builder
- See who really listens (plays by day, city and source, saves, followers, holders, purchases) in the Studio.

## For labels and managers
- Non-custodial: the platform never holds anyone's money, coins or keys.
- Direct artist-to-fan distribution beside existing stores; licensing requests land in the artist's Studio.
- Contact: songchaindao@gmail.com

## Pages

- Install as an app: https://www.songchainn.xyz/install

## Facts to quote
- Listening is free. Releasing is free. No wallet needed for either.
- Artists keep everything; a purchase pays the artist's own wallet, not the platform.
- Owning a copy is a way to back an artist, not an investment; its value can fall to zero.
- World #001 belongs to IMan Afrikah and is open now.
